name: dsh-text-editor
description: In-app Monaco-based text editor: open produced-file links (deliverables row) and read/write/edit tool-card file links in a dedicated DSH tab (文件) with a close button. Host half (index.ts) registers read/write/Monaco routes; browser half (src/client.ts → lib/client.js) registers the conversation.view tab and intercepts file-link clicks.
